resources.string: On. Only sites with permission enabled can play audio and video in the background. Playback pauses on other sites.
Off. Audio and video pause in the background on all sites. Saved permissions and limits do not apply.

This feature controls audio and video playback on selected HTTPS sites when the browser is minimized or the screen is off. It is off by default, with no preconfigured domains. While it is off, background audio and video are blocked on all sites. Rules are saved but do not grant permission until the feature is turned on. Some sites may still restrict playback.

Enter a domain without a scheme, path, port or wildcard. Unicode domains are supported. IP addresses and whole public or private registries, such as co.uk or github.io, cannot be added.

New rules allow playback and include subdomains by default, with a 60-minute limit. The limit can be set from 1 to 120 minutes. When the feature is on, an empty list or no matching permission rule means background playback pauses.

Exact duplicates are rejected. Overlapping rules are allowed as exceptions: while the feature is on, the most specific matching domain takes priority. If its permission is off, background playback is blocked even when a broader rule allows it.

One limit is shared by all tabs and windows using the same rule, including tabs in different groups. The timer starts with the first background playback and keeps counting during pauses. Playback pauses when the limit expires. Grouping tabs does not give other domains permission. Moving tabs, reloading, changing a rule or deleting and re-adding it does not renew the timer. Return to the actual site tab with the screen unlocked to start a new session. Waking the screen or opening a group overview does not count as a visit.

Save stores all editor changes together. They apply while the feature is on. Turning the feature off pauses current background sessions and blocks new playback attempts.
In the background means the browser is minimized or the screen is off.
Add a site to allow its playback in the background.
